selection_rule: top-12 signatures per op by real-traffic call count, plus the smallest and largest input footprint, plus one signature per capture group; warmup-only signatures excluded  Carved out of glm47_flash__triton_attention by tools/split_task_op.py: one op, rows whose q ends 20x576.

capture_modifiers: --disable-cuda-graph (python-level ops are invisible inside a captured graph)

tensors phase adds --disable-radix-cache (radix cache rewrites mamba/state pool rows outside the kernel call and breaks the state chain; shapes phase keeps radix ON so prefix-hit-driven chunk lengths stay realistic)
capture_provenance.note: Every row in this file comes from one of these four groups; the accuracy column is the GSM8K score of the very run the tensors were taken from.
